description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeSalaryDao component of the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing CRUD operations and data retrieval related to employee salary entities within the HRM plugin module.

classes.name: EmployeeSalaryDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing EmployeeSalaryDao functions within the OrangeHRM HRM system, verifying operations like save, delete, and fetch salaries, including associated direct debit data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including creating an EmployeeSalaryDao instance and populating test data from YAML fixtures.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeSalary entity without direct debit, verifying persistence and data correctness.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeSalaryWithEmployeeDirectDebit
methods.description: Tests saving an EmployeeSalary entity with associated EmpDirectDebit, verifying all related data is correctly saved and retrieved.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests deletion of specific employee salary records and verifies associated direct debit records are handled correctly.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeSalariesBulk
methods.description: Tests bulk deletion of multiple employee salary records and checks all are removed.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalary
methods.description: Tests retrieval of specific employee salary entries, including cases with and without direct debit associations.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalaries
methods.description: Tests fetching multiple salaries for an employee, including sorting order verification.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeSalariesCount
methods.description: Tests counting the number of salaries for an employee.
